svg.title: The trust boundaries
svg.desc: Four boundaries meet at Paperless Unified Search on the Nextcloud server. 1, the browser of an administrator sends the settings. 2, the unified search or the smart picker of a user sends the term and the page. 3, the app sends the term and the token to Paperless-ngx outside the server and gets an untrusted answer. 4, the app looks into the folders of the user for files of the archive account. The token stays in the credentials manager of the server.
